context: The speaker is a random human woman who lives next door to the infamous Blushing Mermaid tavern and is fed up with the city’s crime and the regular pubfights that damage her home. She insists a builder — someone “the manip” had promised would arrive a tenday ago — was due to fix the place, and when the player turns up she quickly realizes they aren’t that builder and bluntly dismisses them. Player replies can either be sarcastic or offer practical help (e.g., “I’m handy with a hammer and chisel”), which leads to different dialog branches. In some related lines this gruff neighbor also grouses about criminals taking over an abandoned house and can hint at a missing child and a hag support-group connection, while other surrounding cluster contexts (guards, sahuagin aftermath) may change tone or availability of these remarks.
